intent: Present two distinct analytical frameworks side by side: a multi-column rubric on the left, a stat grid on the right.
invariants: left panel: section kicker + subtitle line, then 3 equal-width rubric columns
each rubric column has colored header bar, bold caption label (white on color), and body text below
rubric columns use muted (accent_5) background with distinct accent colors per column header
right panel: section kicker + subtitle line, then 2x3 stat grid
each stat cell has accent bar on left edge, large number (metric_value token style), and caption label
stat cells have subtle border (accent_6) on white background
max 3 accent colors: accent_1 (healthy), accent_2 (over-reliance/stat bars), accent_6 (avoidance)
variables: rubric column header text and associated color
rubric body text length (20-100 chars per column)
section kicker and subtitle text for each panel
header bar kicker and title text
